question: How should PaperServe recover when the initial retrieval miss omits the gold context-frontier paper?

candidate_papers.title: Vector Recall Is Not Context Routing
candidate_papers.text: Initial retrieval can return a plausible vector-search hard negative that lacks the required context-frontier evidence.

candidate_papers.title: Long Context Windows Without Evidence Selection
candidate_papers.text: Initial retrieval can also surface long-context advice that does not prove the PaperServe frontier contract.

candidate_papers.title: PaperServe: Context Frontiers for Evidence-Bounded Readers
candidate_papers.text: After verifier feedback, the second retrieval recovers the gold paper. It states that only the selected context frontier reaches the reader.

candidate_papers.title: Workflow Scheduling for Background Jobs
candidate_papers.text: A scheduler retry is not the same as verifier-driven evidence recovery for the reader frontier.

expected_answer_points: The first attempt may miss the gold paper.
Verifier feedback should report missing required evidence.
A second retrieval should recover the gold paper and answer with citation.
